assessmentQuestionVersion.questionText: Mechanical refrigeration is preferred and may be required, or an equivalent method must be used to consistently maintain potentially hazardous foods at 4°C (40°F) or below at all times. Maintain internal food temperature at 4°C (40°F) or below at all times. Transportation time to event will be within 2 hours.
